# VS Code extension instructions

Follow the [repository rules](../../.github/copilot-instructions.md) and
[extension development guidance](instructions/extension-development.instructions.md).
Build, packaging, and local testing procedures are in
[`DEVELOPMENT.md`](../DEVELOPMENT.md).

Excel usage guidance comes from the repository's canonical skill templates and
shared references. Do not maintain a separate tool reference here or edit the
generated skill bundled with the extension.
